title: 4port TJ Box TV Model No TV-102

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The 4-Port TJ Box TV Model No: TV-102 is a durable and efficient cable junction box designed for TV, networking, and FTTH applications. With four output ports, this TJ box ensures clean cable management, stable signal distribution, and long-lasting performance for both home and commercial setups. It is built with high-quality plastic to provide protection from dust, heat, and physical damage, making it a reliable choice for structured cabling projects in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • 4-Port Cable Junction Box – Ideal for TV, FTTH, and network cable distribution.
  • High-Quality ABS Material – Strong, heat-resistant, and durable for long-term use.
  • Perfect for TV Line Distribution – Suitable for cable TV, IPTV, and network TV setups.
  • Easy Wall-Mount Design – Ensures clean installation and organized cable routing.
  • Secure Cable Protection – Protects internal joints from moisture, dust, and damage.
  • Compact & Professional Finish – Best choice for home, office, and ISP installations.
